title: Capping Assay: Steps 1-2
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare normalization CSV and map wells
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file containing the normalization parameters for each sample using the exact column order and format shown below: `sample conc. (mg/ml),sample volume (µl),water volume (µl),buffer 1 (µl),probe volume (µl),probe tube location (C1-D6),total volume (µl)`. Populate rows with values such as `1,40,50,10,5,A3,105`, `2.2,18.2,71.8,10,5,A3,105`, `2.03,19.7,70.3,10,5,A4,105`. Map each sample directly from the sample plate (slot 1) to the normalized plate (slot 2): well A1 → A1, B1 → B1, …, D2 → D2, etc.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the protocol parameters in the interface as prompted, using the values from the prepared CSV.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it on your computer if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to `More` → `Custom Labware` → `Add Labware` and select the custom labware definition files (JSON format) to upload, if your experiment requires them.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App `Protocol` tab, upload the protocol script file with a `.py` extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical labware on the robot deck exactly as indicated by the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App to calibrate the positions of all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the support articles for tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the ‘Run’ button in the Opentrons App to start the protocol execution.
